requirement.description: The Switch.cases attribute is incorrectly stored as a tuple instead of a dictionary, causing AttributeError when trying to access .items() method in resolve_statement function.
requirement.contract: Switch.cases should be stored as an OrderedDict to support the .items() iteration in the resolve_statement function. The attribute should be initialized properly as a dictionary-like structure.

requirement.description: Missing MemoryData.Init attribute that tests expect to access for memory initialization validation.
requirement.contract: Add the missing MemoryData.Init attribute to support proper initialization validation in tests.

requirement.description: Incorrect error message formatting for memory initialization count validation that doesn't match expected regex patterns in tests.
requirement.contract: Error messages for memory initialization validation should match the expected patterns exactly, including proper capitalization and wording.

requirement.description: Missing dependency on vcd.gtkw module that prevents VCD signal tracing functionality from working.
requirement.contract: Ensure that the vcd.gtkw module is properly imported or handle the missing import gracefully.

requirement.description: Incorrect handling of certain value conversions that cause TypeError when trying to cast invalid objects like 1.0 to Amaranth values.
requirement.contract: Improve error handling for invalid value casting to provide clearer error messages that match expected patterns in tests.
